+"""Generate the fixed-instance cube-and-banana trajectory."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull
+
+from rcb_robolab import Session
+
+
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+TRAJECTORY = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+
+
+def generate(session: Session) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict]:
+    s = session
+    p = s.primitives()
+    s.reset()
+    obj = s.objects()
+    bowl = np.asarray(obj["bowl"]["position"], dtype=float)
+    qdown = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)
+
+    s.record_start()
+
+    # Cube USD origin is offset from the cube's visual center, so use its AABB center.
+    cube = np.asarray(s.object_bounds("rubiks_cube").mean(axis=0), dtype=float)
+    p["open_gripper"](3)
+    p["move_ee"]([cube[0], cube[1], 0.22], qdown, speed=0.18)
+    p["move_ee"]([cube[0], cube[1], cube[2] + 0.008], qdown, speed=0.10, settle=4)
+    p["close_gripper"](12)
+    p["move_ee"]([cube[0], cube[1], 0.24], qdown, speed=0.14)
+
+    # Place the cube on the bowl floor, then retreat clear of the rim.
+    p["move_ee"]([bowl[0], bowl[1], 0.29], qdown, speed=0.17)
+    p["move_ee"]([bowl[0], bowl[1], 0.093], qdown, speed=0.10, settle=4)
+    p["open_gripper"](15)
+    p["move_ee"]([bowl[0], bowl[1], 0.26], qdown, speed=0.15)
+    p["hold"](15)
+
+    # The banana's origin is outside its thick middle. Find the middle cross-section
+    # from its mesh points and close across its short (x) direction.
+    banana_root = np.asarray(s.object_pose("banana")[0], dtype=float)
+    banana_pts = s.object_points("banana")
+    mid_slice = banana_pts[np.abs(banana_pts[:, 1] - banana_root[1]) < 0.01]
+    banana_x = 0.5 * (mid_slice[:, 0].min() + mid_slice[:, 0].max())
+    qbanana = p["top_down_quat"](p["yaw_for_closing_dir"]([1.0, 0.0]))
+    p["open_gripper"](3)
+    p["move_ee"]([banana_x, banana_root[1], 0.22], qbanana, speed=0.18)
+    p["move_ee"]([banana_x, banana_root[1], 0.065], qbanana, speed=0.09, settle=5)
+    p["close_gripper"](18)
+    p["move_ee"]([banana_x, banana_root[1], 0.23], qbanana, speed=0.12)
+    p["hold"](30)
+
+    # Aim the banana's convex-hull centroid at the bowl center. This also accounts
+    # for any small rotation caused by the grasp.
+    banana_pts = s.object_points("banana")
+    hull_center = banana_pts[ConvexHull(banana_pts).vertices].mean(axis=0)
+    ee = s.ee_pose()[0]
+    ee_to_center = hull_center - ee
+    target_center = np.array([bowl[0], bowl[1], 0.15], dtype=float)
+    target_ee = target_center - ee_to_center
+    p["move_ee"]([target_ee[0], target_ee[1], 0.29], qbanana, speed=0.17)
+    p["move_ee"](target_ee, qbanana, speed=0.10, settle=5)
+    p["open_gripper"](15)
+    p["hold"](40)
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    result = s.status()
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, TRAJECTORY, meta={"strategy": "cube then banana", "live_status": result})
+    return actions, result
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    Path(TRAJECTORY).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    session = Session("rubiks_cube_and_banana", instance=INSTANCE)
+    actions, result = generate(session)
+    print(f"saved {len(actions)} actions to {TRAJECTORY}; status={result}")
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
